capabilities: Add Ask, Edit, Praise or Note comment threads to selected text as CriticMarkup
Suggest insertions, deletions and substitutions with accept/reject actions
Browse and filter open threads per note, folder or whole vault in a panel
Export review reports and copy AI working instructions to the clipboard
Run a bridge script that hands open threads to the claude CLI and writes answers back as suggestions
disambiguation: Not a code-review tool; it annotates note text with CriticMarkup threads that an AI agent can work through.
extras: The plugin itself has no network access; AI work requires a separate agent tool on the machine. The fork was developed with substantial LLM assistance and some interface strings are machine-translated. The bridge backs up every touched note before writing.
intentEvidence: Fork of shotashirai1719/obsidian-review-comments by Shota Shirai (AGPL-3.0).
motivation: The author forked the original because 'Resolve' deleted comments, losing the reasoning so an AI could no longer tell what a passage was about; this fork keeps threads in the note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hold review discussions inside a note in a format an external AI coding assistant can read and answer.

relations.evidence: Fork of shotashirai1719/obsidian-review-comments by Shota Shirai (AGPL-3.0).

requires.name: claude CLI or another AI agent command

summary: CriticMarkup review-comment plugin that keeps threaded inline comments in the note so AI agents like Claude Code can read, edit and reply in place.
